item.title: Gamification fails when it turns into surveillance or burnout
item.description: Disney's electronic whip, FarmVille's withering crops, and Yahoo Answers' point system share a structural failure: each was designed around what's easy to measure, not around what sustains the behavior the designers actually wanted.
